newsitem.title: LEBANON: Pro-Israeli militiaman wounded in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Pro-Israeli militiaman wounded in south Lebanon.

text.p: A pro-Israeli militiaman was wounded on Tuesday when Moslem guerrillas set off a bomb near his patrol in south Lebanon, militia sources said.

They said the blast occurred as South Lebanon Army (SLA) militiamen were on a foot patrol near the outpost of Anan in Jizzine, a finger of territory officially outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone but under SLA control.

No group claimed responsibility for the attack, which brought to four the number of SLA soldiers wounded in guerrilla attacks since the beginning of the year. One Israeli soldier was killed and 11 were wounded over the same period.
The pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) leads an Islamic Resistance committed to ousting Israeli troops and their allies from the 15 km (nine mile) wide border zone.
